summary: These edits add specific keywords to each category to reduce ambiguity and improve routing accuracy. The changes are minimal and focused on clarifying existing routes without altering the overall structure.

diffs.rationale: Add explicit keywords to differentiate career planning from general career questions.
diffs.original_excerpt: 職涯規劃（轉職、升遷、職涯方向、長期規劃、職務轉換）→ CareerPlanAgent
diffs.replacement: 職涯規劃（轉職、升遷、職涯方向、長期規劃、職務轉換、職涯諮商、職涯探索、轉職策略）→ CareerPlanAgent

diffs.rationale: Add specific keywords related to job search to avoid confusion with salary negotiation.
diffs.original_excerpt: 求職過程、面試階段）→ SalaryAgent
diffs.replacement: 求職過程、面試階段、履歷投遞、職場搜尋、求職策略）→ SalaryAgent

diffs.rationale: Add explicit terms for industry insights to distinguish from general workplace questions.
diffs.original_excerpt: 一般職場問題（如團隊合作、職場溝通、辦公室政治）同樣直接使用 queryCareerKB 工具回答，無需路由到子 agent。
diffs.replacement: 產業洞察（如新創公司、大企業、產業趨勢、職業生態）與一般職場問題（如團隊合作、職場溝通、辦公室政治）同樣直接使用 queryCareerKB 工具回答，無需路由到子 agent。

diffs.rationale: Clarify the distinction between skill development and career planning by adding specific keywords.
diffs.original_excerpt: 技能發展（語言能力、專業技能、學習資源、職場軟實力）可直接使用 queryCareerKB 工具回答，無需路由到子 agent。
diffs.replacement: 技能發展（語言能力、專業技能、學習資源、職場軟實力、證照考取、課程推薦、技能鑑定）可直接使用 queryCareerKB 工具回答，無需路由到子 agent。

diffs.rationale: Add specific resume-related keywords to avoid confusion with job search.
diffs.original_excerpt: 履歷相關（撰寫、格式、ATS、自傳、投遞策略、求職過程）→ ResumeAgent
diffs.replacement: 履歷相關（撰寫、格式、ATS、自傳、投遞策略、求職過程、履歷優化、簡歷調整）→ ResumeAgent
